title: Roach project state
description: .agent/STATE.json. Project status answers whether work should proceed; phase answers what kind of work is appropriate. They are deliberately independent, so a project can be paused during planning without losing its place.

protocol_version.description: Run `roach.py migrate` to bring an older project forward.

project_status.description: Only active offers claimable work. complete is entered exclusively through the gated completion transition.

phase.description: planning, execution, and complete all require accepted product intent. complete phase and complete status must agree.

command.description: The exact command that ran. Completion re-checks this against the currently configured one.

commit.description: HEAD when verification ran. Completion refuses if product code changed since; coordination-only commits do not invalidate it.

blocked.description: Required non-empty when project_status is blocked or paused, and null otherwise.

adoption.description: How this project came to use Roach. greenfield means it was created from the template; brownfield means the method was installed into a repository that already had code and history, which is why commits before baseline_commit reference no task. It also decides whether AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are template-owned or project-owned during upgrade.

baseline_commit.description: Last commit before adoption. Brownfield only; history at or before it predates the method.
